notes: Assumptions that move the number: 8 SA large eggs × 55 g (629 kcal); ½ cup grated cheddar ≈ 55 g; 1 tbsp olive oil, all of it in the muffins and tin. Net carbs 5.9 g a serving and fat 61 % of energy, so it meets the keto rule (≤ 10 g, ≥ 60 %) as well as banting — the fat share is close to the line. Cross-check: published vegetable egg muffins list ~70–90 kcal each, ~250–300 for three; 280 agrees. Published figures are recalled, not re-fetched (the shared web budget was spent).
